title: Multi Group Scouting EA - EMA3/8/45 trend cross with grid recovery
entry_long: EMA(3) crosses above EMA(45) at ID1, confirmed EMA(3) below EMA(45) for 9 preceding candles (ID2-ID9) = clear uptrend, sets buy-mode flag; actual buy entry waits for price to pull back and cross back up through EMA(8) slow
entry_short: mirror: EMA(3) crosses below EMA(45), confirmed downtrend over 9 candles, sets sell-mode; entry waits for price pullback up then cross down through EMA(8) slow
exit: no SL/TP on individual orders; group-close when combined buy+sell floating profit > $3; trailing-stop block (30 pips/step1) manages profit-taking on trend-following add-ons; recovery mode adds grid orders every 60 pips confirmed by RSI(7) oversold<30 (buy) / overbought>70 (sell)
buildon_idea: already capped at 0.1 lot via Volume Upper Limit; try widening the 9-candle trend confirmation to 20-30 candles (author's own suggestion) to filter sideways whipsaw before build-on testing
novelty_note: multi-EMA trend gate + RSI-gated grid recovery combo; author explicitly frames this as an improved version of EX151 to work on high-spread symbols (gold) - moderate novelty

title: Multi EMA Scalping EA - EMA5/12/50 cross with price-cross-indicator whipsaw filter
symbol: XAUUSD (low-spread account, e.g. GX Zero Space)
entry_long: EMA(5) crosses above EMA(50) confirmed by 9-candle trend check, sets buy-mode; actual entry uses Price-Cross-Above-Indicator on EMA(12) slow with a minimum-turnover-distance tolerance block to avoid false triggers from price/indicator jitter
entry_short: mirror: EMA(5) crosses below EMA(50), Price-Cross-Below-Indicator on EMA(12) slow with same anti-whipsaw filter
exit: stop-loss = lowest/highest price over lookback candles ID1-ID9 (custom price-level SL, not fixed pips); profitable side pyramids every 100 pips (fixed 0.01 lot per add) with trailing-stop 50pips/step1 managing the group
escalation_cap: n/a (fixed 0.01 lot per add, capped overall at 0.1 lot Volume Upper Limit)
buildon_idea: already has a real SL (candle-range based) unlike sibling examples; build-on: test the swing-high/low SL against ATR-based SL for consistency across spread regimes; author warns real-account System-Error lot-jump risk if Volume Upper Limit omitted - keep that cap
novelty_note: notable for actually having a stop-loss unlike most fxDreema examples in this batch, plus explicit anti-whipsaw block (Price-Cross-Above/Below-Indicator with minimum turnover distance) - moderate-high novelty for this corpus

title: Multi Group Scouting EA - ZigZag swing High/Low trend detection
entry_long: ZigZag High[0] > High[1] (rising swing highs = uptrend) -> open buy immediately, group 1
entry_short: ZigZag Low[0] < Low[1] (falling swing lows = downtrend) -> open sell immediately, group 2
exit: no SL/TP on entries; grid-recovery adds every 15 pips (linear +0.01 lot per 5-order step) in trend-following and reverse-trend modes; trailing-stop 10 pips/step1 manages profit; group close at $3 combined profit
buildon_idea: already capped 0.2 lot; grid/lot-escalation mechanism shared across EX150-153 series - test swapping the ZigZag entry alone into the EX150 recovery engine for a cleaner concept split; author notes it also works on high-spread symbols
novelty_note: simplest entry logic in this batch - raw ZigZag swing comparison, no confirmation filter; low novelty but tested across 5 years (2020-2024) per author claim

title: Multi Group Scouting EA - MACD(H1) signal filtered by EMA5/10/100 alignment + distance cap, traded M5
entry_long: MACD main line on H1 above zero AND rising for 2+ candles sets buy-mode; entry on M5 requires EMA5>EMA10>EMA100 alignment AND price-to-EMA5 distance <500 pips (avoid overpaying), then opens 0.05 lot
entry_short: mirror: MACD(H1) below zero and falling sets sell-mode; EMA5<EMA10<EMA100 alignment AND distance filter <500 pips
exit: no SL/TP; grid recovery every 500 pips with candle-pattern confirmation (2-candle reversal check) before adding; trailing-stop 500pips/step1; group close at combined profit >$20 OR order count hits Max Order(50)
escalation_cap: 1.0 lot (Volume Upper Limit); step +0.01 lot every 5 orders
buildon_idea: already capped 1.0 lot + Max Order 50 hard cap; build-on: the multi-timeframe MACD(H1)->M5 filter plus distance cap is reusable as a standalone signal module independent of the grid-recovery engine; author reports >100% profit / 23% DD over 9mo, worth isolating entry logic for EDGE_CATALOG
novelty_note: multi-timeframe MACD trend filter combined with distance-from-EMA entry throttle - moderately novel combination not seen in prior EMA-only examples

title: MACD(H1) Histogram trend filter controlling M1 entries with EMA3/8/200 pullback confirmation
entry_long: MACD(H1) above zero with histogram bars ID1>ID2>ID3>ID4 (strengthening uptrend) sets buy-mode; EMA3>EMA8>EMA200 alignment confirms; waits for pullback then cross back above EMA fast/slow before entering 0.1 lot
entry_short: mirror: MACD(H1) below zero with histogram bars increasingly negative (ID1<ID2<ID3<ID4), EMA3<EMA8<EMA200 alignment, waits for pullback rally then cross down before entering
exit: no SL/TP; profitable side pyramids every 100 pips (fixed lot); losing side adds recovery orders every 100 pips with lot doubling via linear +0.01 increments; group close at combined profit threshold (value unspecified in transcript, cut off before results shown)
buildon_idea: already capped at 0.1 lot; this is a re-explained variant of the same MACD(H1)->intraday entry concept as the other EX153 card - build-on should treat them as one family and dedupe before testing
novelty_note: same underlying idea as sibling EX153 card (MACD H1 controlling lower-TF entries); transcript is a re-recording/duplicate of the concept without final backtest numbers shown

title: MACD Divergence + 3-candle Price Pattern confirmation, Match-Power exponential lot recovery
entry_long: bullish MACD divergence detected, then confirmed by 3-candle pattern: ID3 and ID2 bearish candles (open>close), ID1 bullish reversal candle (open<close) -> open buy at Lot_Start
entry_short: bearish MACD divergence detected, then confirmed by ID3/ID2 bullish candles, ID1 bearish reversal candle -> open sell at Lot_Start
exit: take-profit 10 pips (as-position, closes both buy+sell groups together); cut-loss at -3000 cents (~-$30 on $10,000/cent account); losing side adds recovery order every 10 pips with lot = Lot_Start * multiple^(open_order_count) via MathPower function (multiple=2), i.e. exponential doubling
escalation_cap: none (no Volume Upper Limit or Max Order constant shown; only bounded by -3000 cent equity cutloss)
buildon_idea: MUST add a lot-size cap (Volume Upper Limit) or hard order-count cap before any further testing - author uses MathPower(2, order_count) with no ceiling, relying only on an account-level cutloss; also worth flat-lot testing the divergence+pattern entry alone (author claims high win-rate from divergence+pattern combo) before judging the martingale engine separately
novelty_note: combines FXDreema's built-in MACD divergence signal blocks with a 3-candle reversal confirmation filter, plus introduces the MathPower() exponential lot function as a reusable martingale technique - notable for technique reuse potential

title: MACD Divergence + 3-candle Price Pattern confirmation (re-recording), Match-Power exponential lot recovery
entry_long: bullish MACD divergence, confirmed by ID3/ID2 bearish candles then ID1 bullish reversal candle -> open buy at Lot_Start (0.01)
entry_short: bearish MACD divergence, confirmed by ID3/ID2 bullish candles then ID1 bearish reversal candle -> open sell at Lot_Start
exit: take-profit 10 pips as-position (closes buy+sell groups together); losing side adds recovery order every 10 pips (grid distance) with lot = Lot_Start * multiple^(order_count) via MathPower (multiple=2), exponential doubling; no cutloss constant shown in this transcript variant
escalation_cap: none (no Volume Upper Limit, no Max Order, no cutloss constant mentioned in this version)
buildon_idea: same as sibling EX154 card - add a hard lot/order cap before building on; this variant is even less capped (no equity cutloss mentioned at all); author reports ~300% profit over ~6yr backtest which is a strong martingale red flag needing MC/robustness testing before any trust
novelty_note: duplicate concept of sibling EX154(d8_TWoRtUeo) - same MACD-divergence+pattern+MathPower martingale idea, re-taught; treat as one concept for cataloging purposes

title: Multigroup Scalping EA - Inside Bar pattern + EMA3/8/200 with ATR-adaptive trailing stop
symbol: unspecified (author demos on M1, mentions adaptable)
entry_long: trend-following mode gate (Buy mode toggle) + bullish inside-bar pattern (ID3 up big-body>=50pips, ID2 down small body, ID1 up big-body>=50pips, close ID2>open ID3, close ID1>open ID2) + EMA3>EMA8>EMA200 alignment + price within 100 pips of EMA3 -> open buy at min lot
entry_short: mirror bearish inside-bar pattern + EMA3<EMA8<EMA200 alignment + distance filter -> open sell at min lot
exit: no fixed SL/TP; trend-following add every 60 pips; recovery-mode add every 60 pips with lot step +0.01 every 5 orders (capped Max Order=50 per side); trailing-stop distance dynamically scaled by ATR*60pips*2 (higher volatility = wider trailing stop) instead of fixed pips; group close via profit formula that scales close-target with open order count
escalation_cap: ~0.1 lot (Volume Upper Limit, value partly garbled in transcript) plus hard Max Order=50 cap
buildon_idea: already capped via Volume Upper Limit + Max Order=50; the ATR-scaled trailing-stop distance (volatility-adaptive SL) is a genuinely reusable technique worth extracting into EDGE_CATALOG independent of this EA's grid-recovery engine; author recommends trend-following-only mode for better performance
novelty_note: ATR-adaptive trailing-stop distance (stop widens/narrows with market liquidity/volatility) is the standout novel technique here, layered onto an inside-bar + 3-EMA entry - higher novelty than plain fixed-pip trailing stops seen elsewhere in corpus

title: Multigroup Scouting EA - Inside Bar pattern + EMA3/8/50, tested on XAUUSD M15
entry_long: bullish inside-bar: ID3 up (body>=50pips), ID2 down small pullback not breaking ID3 open, ID1 up reversal closing above ID2 open (bullish engulf of ID2) + EMA3>EMA8>EMA50 alignment + price within 100 pips of EMA3 -> open buy 0.02 lot, group 1
entry_short: mirror bearish inside-bar (ID3 down, ID2 up pullback, ID1 down reversal engulfing ID2) + EMA3<EMA8<EMA50 alignment + distance filter -> open sell 0.02 lot, group 2
exit: no SL/TP; recovery adds every 60 pips confirmed by a small reversal-candle check (3-candle pattern) before adding, lot step +0.01 every 3 orders; trailing-stop 30 pips/step2 on trend-following side; group close at combined profit >$3
buildon_idea: already capped 0.2 lot; author reports low DD (10.8%) and decent profit (17-18% over 9mo) on XAUUSD M15 with relatively few trades (1600 orders/9mo) - good candidate to build on by testing across more symbols/TFs since low trade frequency suggests low overfitting risk vs peers in this batch
novelty_note: same inside-bar+EMA concept as sibling EX155(6HZ091AY-KQ) card but with fixed-distance trailing stop instead of ATR-adaptive; treat as related but distinct implementation with actual backtest numbers shown
